title: SSD-LLaMA runs trillion-parameter MoE models from consumer storage
friendlyTitle: Researchers ran a huge AI model using an ordinary SSD and one powerful graphics card
summary: SSD-LLaMA streams mixture-of-experts model components across SSD, RAM and GPU memory instead of requiring the whole model in expensive memory. The researchers report more than one generated token per second for a trillion-parameter model on one RTX 5090 with no more than 32GB of RAM.
friendlySummary: SSD-LLaMA moves only the needed parts of a very large model between storage, memory and the graphics card. In tests, it ran a trillion-parameter model at just over one token each second.
whyItMatters: The result is research rather than a ready-made consumer app, and one token per second is slow. Even so, storage-native inference could widen local access to very large open models and reduce dependence on cloud hardware for experiments that tolerate latency.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It is slow and still experimental, but it could make very large open models easier to study without a data-centre computer.
